Name: NAACC Code
Description: North Atlantic Aquatic Connectivity Collaborative (NAACC) Crossing Code (xy and decimal latitude and longitude)

Name: Road
Description: Road name

Name: Stream Name
Description: Stream name from USGS topographic maps, no data=no stream name available

Name: Town/City
Description: Town/City name

Name: HUC8 Watershed
Description: Hydrologic Unit Code 8-digit name

Name: HUC12 Watershed
Description: Hydrologic Unit Code 12-digit name

Name: Latitude
Description: Latitude in decimal degrees

Name: Longitude
Description: Longitude in decimal degrees

Name: Drainage Area
Description: Area that drains to a point on a stream
Citation: Drainage area determine from digital elevation models derived from lidar data (Massachusetts Bureau of Geographic Information, 2022, MassGIS data: lidar terrain data, website accessed April 22, 2022 at https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massgis-data-lidar-terrain-data).

Name: Mean Basin Elevation
Description: Mean basin elevation
Citation: Zarriello, P.J., 2017, Magnitude of flood flows at selected annual exceedance probabilities for streams in Massachusetts: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report 2016–5156, 54 p., https://doi.org/10.3133/sir20165156.

Name: Percent Storage from NLCD2006
Description: Percentage of water bodies and wetlands determined from the NLCD 2006
Citation: Zarriello, P.J., 2017, Magnitude of flood flows at selected annual exceedance probabilities for streams in Massachusetts: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report 2016–5156, 54 p., https://doi.org/10.3133/sir20165156.

Name: Mean Basin Slope from 10m DEM
Description: Mean basin slope computed from 10 m DEM
Citation: Bent, G.C., and Waite, A.M., 2013, Equations for estimating bankfull channel geometry and discharge for streams in Massachusetts: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report 2013–5155, 62 p., http://dx.doi.org/10.3133/sir20135155.

Name: 10-year Peakflow
Description: Maximum instantaneous flow that occurs with a 10% annual exceedance probability
Citation: Zarriello, P.J., 2017, Magnitude of flood flows at selected annual exceedance probabilities for streams in Massachusetts: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report 2016–5156, 54 p., https://doi.org/10.3133/sir20165156.

Name: 25-year Peakflow
Description: Maximum instantaneous flow that occurs with a 4% annual exceedance probability

Name: 50-year Peakflow
Description: Maximum instantaneous flow that occurs with a 2% annual exceedance probability

Name: 100-year Peakflow
Description: Maximum instantaneous flow that occurs with a 1% annual exceedance probability

Name: 500-year Peakflow
Description: Maximum instantaneous flow that occurs with a 0.2% annual exceedance probability

Name: Bankfull Width
Description: Bankfull width = width of stream channel at bankfull
Citation: Bent, G.C., and Waite, A.M., 2013, Equations for estimating bankfull channel geometry and discharge for streams in Massachusetts: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report 2013–5155, 62 p., http://dx.doi.org/10.3133/sir20135155.

Name: Bankfull Mean Depth
Description: Mean bankfull depth = mean water depth of the stream channel at bankfull

Name: Coldwater Fisheries Resources
Description: Stream is a Coldwater Fisheries: 0=no, 1=yes, no data=no available information
Citation: Massachusetts Division of Fisheries and Wildlife, 2025, MA wildlife coldwater fish resources, website accessed April 30, 2025 at https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massgis-data-ma-wildlife-coldwater-fisheries-resources.

Name: Areas of Critical Environmental Concerns
Description: Stream is an Area of Critical Environmental Concerns: 0=no, 1=yes, no data=no available information
Citation: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation, 2025, ACEC program overview: website, accessed February 24, 2025 at https://www.mass.gov/info-details/acec-program-overview.

Name: BioMap
Description: Stream is in a BioMap area: 0=no, 1=yes, no data=no available information
Citation: Massachusetts Division of Fisheries and Wildlife and The Nature Conservancy, 2025, BioMap the future of conservation in Massachusetts: website, accessed July 28, 2025 at https://biomap-mass-eoeea.hub.arcgis.com/.

Name: Wild and Scenic Rivers
Description: Stream is a Wild and Scenic River: 0=no, 1=yes, no data=no available information
Citation: National Wild and Scenic Rivers System, 2025, Massachusetts: website, accessed April 30, 2025 at https://www.rivers.gov/massachusetts.

Name: Diadromous Fish Run
Description: Stream is a Diadromous fish run: 0=no, 1=yes, no data=no available information
Citation: Massachusetts Bureau of Geographic Information, 2025, MassGIS data, diadromous fish website, accessed March 3, 2025 at https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massgis-data-diadromous-fish.

Name: Critical Linkages
Description: Critical Linkages Percentile: >25% = other, top 20 <= 25% = medium restoration potential, top 10 <= 20% = high restoration potential, top 5 <= 10% = higher restoration potential, and top 0 <= 5% = highest restoration potential and projected mean summer temperature <= 16 degrees Celsius, no data=no available information
Citation: University of Massachusetts at Amherst, Conservation Assessment and Prioritization System, 2022, The critical linkage project: website, accessed April 30, 2022 at http://www.umasscaps.org/applications/critical-linkages.html.

Name: Coldwater Critical Linkages
Description: Coldwater Critical Linkages Percentile: >40%=other, top 30-40%=medium, top 20-30%=high, top 10-20%=higher, and top 0-10%=highest restoration potential and projected mean summer temperature <= 16 degrees Celsius, no data=no available information
Citation: University of Massachusetts at Amherst, Conservation Assessment and Prioritization System, 2022, The critical linkage project: website, accessed April 30, 2022 at http://www.umasscaps.org/applications/critical-linkages.html.

Name: Habitat Quality Category
Description: Habitat quality score: Sum of 'yes' (value=1) for Coldwater Fisheries, Area of Critical Environmental Concern, BioMap, Wild and Scenic River, Diadromous Fish Run (General quality = 0, high quality = 1, highest quality = >=2), no data=no available information
Citation: Scott Jackson, University of Massachusetts at Amherst, written commun., 2022

Name: Restoration Connectivity Potential Category
Description: Connectivity Restoration Potential (RP) Score: Derived from the lower category of the RPCLINK or RCPWLINK classifications (other, medium R, high RP, higher RP, and highest RP) and projected mean summer temperature <= 16 degrees Celsius, no data=no available information
Citation: Scott Jackson, University of Massachusetts at Amherst, written commun., 2022

Name: Roadway Classification
Description: Roadway classification code values (0=Local, 1=Interstate, 2=Rural or urban principal arterial, 3=Rural minor arterial or urban principal, 4=Rural minor arterial or urban principal, 5=Urban minor arterial or rural major, 6=Urban collector or rural minor)
Citation: Massachusetts Department of Transportation, 2025, Road Inventory 2024, accessed September 20, 2025 at  https://geo-massdot.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/MassDOT::road-inventory-2024/about.

Name: Hydraulic Design Flood
Description: Hydraulic Design Flood Recurrence Interval: 10-yr, 25-yr, 50-yr, and 100-yr (equivalent to 10-, 4-, 2-, and 1-percent annual exceedance probability (AEP) flood flow, respectively)
Citation: Massachusetts Department of Transportation, 2025, Bridge Manual – Part I, Hundredth Anniversary Edition, January 2025 revision, 26 p, accessed October 1, 2025 at https://massdot.docs.mass.gov/hwy-bridge-manual/part-1/ch2-prelim-engineering-guidelines-w-appendix_0125.pdf.
